arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and for sending the letter from your debt adviser. We're sorry to hear you lost your job, and we understand this is a worrying time.

We have noted the Breathing Space that started on 1 October 2026. While it is in place, we will not contact you about the rent arrears or take action on them. Any arrears matters will go through your adviser, Hackney Money Advice CIC.

Your ongoing rent of £1,850 a month still needs to be paid on the usual date while the Breathing Space runs. If you have any difficulty paying it, please contact us so we can talk about it.

Your proposal for a payment plan has been passed to our management team for a decision. We will not agree a plan with you directly on the arrears, so please keep working with your adviser on that.

If you feel unsafe or need urgent help, please call 999 in an emergency.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings

Current rent of £1,850 a month remains payable.

The tenant has offered £100 a month on top of rent from November. Our management team will decide on that and we will come back to you. Nothing has been agreed.

Mare & Co Lettings

Hi Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and for sending the letter from your debt adviser. We're sorry to hear you lost your job, and we understand this is a worrying time.

We have noted the Breathing Space that started on 1 October 2026. While it is in place, we will not contact you about the rent arrears or take action on them. Any arrears matters will go through your adviser, Hackney Money Advice CIC.

Your ongoing rent of £1,850 a month still needs to be paid on the usual date while the Breathing Space runs. If you have any difficulty paying it, please contact us so we can talk about it.

Your proposal for a payment plan has been passed to our management team for a decision. We will not agree a plan with you directly on the arrears, so please keep working with your adviser on that.

If you feel unsafe or need urgent help, please call 999 in an emergency.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings
